Suggested next step: a 45-minute technical demo / deep-dive where Aditya can walk through model selection, batching strategy, and recommended configs for your peak throughput. Please pick one of these windows (all PST):
  • Tue 3/3 — 9:00–9:45am

If those don’t work, tell me two times that do and I’ll tighten to a single confirmed slot. Also let me know which folks from your side should join (engineering, infra, security).

Attaching a short agenda we’ll use to keep the session focused. If you want a lighter 30-minute call instead we can do that as well.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.
